mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by > 0.5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and suppressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) and declining labor force participation (PAYEMS decline > 0.5% over 3 months) signal economic distress, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.0% AND PAYEMS decline > 0.5% over 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0% and PAYEMS declines by > 0.5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, declining housing starts (HOUST < 1400) coupled with slowing GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate < 2.0% annualized) signal waning consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 1400 AND GDPC1 growth rate < 2.0% annualized
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1400 and GDPC1 growth rate < 2.0% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates weakening supply chain activity, reducing corporate output and profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines by > 1.0% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1400 units (HOUST < 1400) signal weak consumer demand for durable goods, reducing retail sales and corporate revenue, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1400.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 310) and elevated interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) signal persistent monetary tightening, increasing real borrowing costs and equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 310 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In labor market slack, high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) combined with declining payroll growth (PAYEMS growth rate < 0.3% monthly) indicates weak job creation, suppressing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.0% AND PAYEMS growth rate < 0.3% monthly
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0% and PAYEMS growth rate < 0.3% monthly.
